open_issues: Owner decision, unchanged from pass 1: the A01 preview draws twelve 8-character one-time codes with no QR, while the specification and Wakeel.Crypto's RecoveryCode define one 21-character code plus QR. The build follows the specification.

Owner decision, unchanged from pass 1: the A02 preview carries a «تذكر هذا الجهاز ٨ ساعات» tick box. It is deliberately not built — remembering the device would mean a machine-wrapped copy of the database key on disk, which is exactly what the org-root decision avoids.

Owner decision, unchanged from pass 1: the A02 preview's standing note says «١٥ دقيقة بعد ٥ محاولات» where the specification says 30 s doubling. The build follows the specification and the screen says what it actually does.

The clipboard clearing added for finding 4 could not be observed end-to-end in the host: WebView2 refuses navigator.clipboard.readText() in that context (NotAllowedError), and the same sandbox made the copy itself fail when driven from a synthesised click. The failure path was verified instead — the toast now names copying rather than printing.
notes:
Every finding addressed; seven new tests (57 -> 64), all four given commands run verbatim and green with 0 warnings under TreatWarningsAsErrors.

MEDIUM — narrow CryptoException filter (AdminAccountService.SignIn/Recover). Both now use one `catch (CryptoException exception)` and branch inside: WrongPassword/Tampered keep exactly the old behaviour (RecordWrongPassword in SignIn, WrongRecoveryCode in Recover), every other code — Corrupt from a missing Kdf or disagreeing salts, UnknownKind from a wrap version or kind this build does not know — returns AdminAccountRefusal.StorageFailed, which A02's `default:` arm already renders as AdminAr.Errors.DataUnreadable. Two tests spoil a saved wrap (load the key file, `wrap with { Version = KeyWrap.CurrentVersion + 1 }`, save) and assert the refusal instead of a thrown exception, one per method.

LOW — absent vs unreadable key file. Added `AdminAccountService.KeyFileUnreadable` (file exists but TryLoadKeyFile returns null) and a private AbsentOrUnreadable() that SignIn and Recover use where they used to return NotCreated: a present-but-unreadable file now gives StorageFailed. A01.OnInitialized checks the same flag first and stays put with AdminAr.Errors.DataUnreadable instead of redirecting into the bounce loop. Test writes garbage over keys\admin.key and asserts IsCreated, KeyFileUnreadable and StorageFailed from both entry points. Verified live (see below).

LOW — print outcome claimed a print. Added AdminPrintOutcome.DialogOpened; AdminWebView2PrintService.PrintAsync returns it (the interface doc now says no screen may claim a print on the strength of that call), A01 sets _printOpenedAt on it, and the chip is AdminAr.Account.Create.PrintOpenedChip -> «فُتحت نافذة الطباعة dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm». PrintedChip is gone. The «طبعتُ الورقة» tick box remains the only thing that stands for an actual print.

LOW — clipboard. CopiedToast is now «نُسخ الرمز. الصقه في مكانه ثم امسح الحافظة.», A01 remembers that a copy happened, and Start() calls the new wakeelAdmin.clearCopiedText before dropping the sheet, which overwrites the clipboard with an empty string. The live run also exposed a wrong sentence nobody had flagged: a failed copy showed AdminAr.Account.Create.PrintUnavailable («لا تتوفّر الطباعة على هذا الحاسوب») — added CopyFailed («تعذّر نسخ الرمز. اكتبه بخط اليد أو اطبع الورقة.») and used it on both the false-return and JSException paths.

LOW — capped alert counts. AdminDashboard gained `PendingChanges` (a new uncapped COUNT) and `AlertCount` = OfficesWaiting + PendingChanges + RevokedDevices, all read from the tables. A03's WBadge and AlertsSub now come from those three totals instead of counting the drawn list; the LIMIT 20 stays on the rendered rows only, and both the record and ReadAlerts carry doc comments saying nothing may be counted from Alerts. Test seeds 25 waiting offices and asserts OfficesWaiting == 25, AlertCount == 27 and fewer than 25 drawn office lines, with the summary naming 25.

LOW — AlertsNoneDesc on an empty organisation. Now AlertsNoneDesc(bool nothingRegisteredYet): «لا شيء بانتظار الانتباه بعد.» when the board IsEmpty, the old sentence otherwise. A03 passes _board.IsEmpty.

LOW — Arabic agreement on revoked devices. Added AdminAr.Dashboard.RevokedDevices(int) with the four shapes (جهاز مُلغى / جهازان مُلغيان / n أجهزة مُلغاة / n جهازًا مُلغى); AlertsSummary and DevicesRevoked both call it instead of concatenating «مُلغاة» onto Counting.Devices. Test pins all four shapes and both call sites.

LOW — Recover changed the password before the database opened. Reordered: _db.Open(databaseKey) first, then the new password wrap and keyFile.Save; the catch also calls _db.Close() so nothing half-opened is left. Test holds admin.db open with FileShare.None, asserts StorageFailed, then proves the OLD password still signs in.

LOW — unused dependency. QRCoder PackageReference removed from src/Wakeel.Admin/Wakeel.Admin.csproj (it still reaches the output transitively through Wakeel.Admin.UI, which is where AdminRecoveryQr lives). No package added anywhere.

HOST RUN AND LOOKED AT — launched src/Wakeel.Admin/bin/.../Wakeel.Admin.exe twice with --remote-debugging-port=9333 --window-size=1366x768 --data-folder=<scratchpad temp>, driving CDP over a PowerShell ClientWebSocket (no Python on this machine); /json/version answered (Edg/152.0.4191.66) both times. Run 1 from --start-url=/first-run: filled A01, created the account, the once-only sheet appeared with the meta list and grouped code, copied, ticked, «ابدأ» — and I looked at the A03 JPEG: the alerts panel now reads «لا تنبيهات / لا شيء بانتظار الانتباه بعد.» on an organisation with no offices, four KPI cards, seven tabs, no sidebar, full RTL. Run 2 with keys\admin.key deliberately corrupted and --start-url=/sign-in: pressing «دخول» kept the route at /sign-in and showed «تعذّرت قراءة بيانات الأداة على هذا الحاسوب. افتح «الصيانة» لفحصها.» under the field — the flicker loop is gone and, importantly, nothing threw. The log holds only the two «Wakeel admin host starting up» lines. Both processes killed; no Wakeel.Admin survives.

Nothing outside src/Wakeel.Admin.UI, src/Wakeel.Admin, tests/Wakeel.Admin.Tests and docs/build/progress/admin-1.md was touched.
